notre-dame-basilica.name: Notre-Dame Basilica of Montreal
notre-dame-basilica.price_text: ≈ CAD 15–20 adult entry; check current price online
notre-dame-basilica.hours: Generally daily, morning to late afternoon; closed to tourists during Mass — check on the day
notre-dame-basilica.tip: Book the Aura light show in the evening for a very different view of the interior.
notre-dame-basilica.best: Early morning to avoid crowds; evening for the light show

old-montreal.name: Old Montreal
old-montreal.tip: Walk the cobbled streets early before the tour groups arrive, then stop at Place d'Armes.

saint-joseph-oratory.name: Saint Joseph's Oratory
saint-joseph-oratory.hours: Daily, roughly 06:30–21:00 — check on the day
saint-joseph-oratory.tip: Climb the outdoor staircase on your knees only if you wish; the terrace view over the city is free.

place-jacques-cartier.name: Place Jacques-Cartier
place-jacques-cartier.hours: Always open; restaurants and stalls in season
place-jacques-cartier.tip: In summer it is a pedestrian square with buskers — sit at a terrace and watch the crowd.
place-jacques-cartier.best: Late afternoon and evening in summer

habitat-67.name: Habitat 67
habitat-67.hours: Exterior viewable any time; it is a private residence
habitat-67.tip: See it from the waterfront promenade or the river bank opposite — you cannot go inside.
habitat-67.best: Daytime; good light from the river side

la-ronde.name: La Ronde: A Six Flags Park
la-ronde.landmark: La Ronde: A Six Flags Park
la-ronde.price_text: One-day ticket roughly CAD 50–80 depending on date — check online
la-ronde.hours: Seasonal, roughly May to October; hours vary — check on the day
la-ronde.tip: Buy tickets online in advance and go on a weekday to cut queue times.
la-ronde.best: Weekday in summer, arrive at opening

mcgill.name: McGill University
mcgill.hours: Campus open daily; buildings have their own hours
mcgill.tip: Walk up to the lower campus from downtown and continue into Mount Royal Park.

underground-city.name: Montreal Underground City
underground-city.hours: Mall hours roughly 10:00–21:00; varies by building
underground-city.tip: It is a network of tunnels and malls, not one sight — enter near a metro station and follow signs.
underground-city.best: Rainy days or winter; weekday daytime

place-des-arts.name: Place des Arts
place-des-arts.price_text: Varies by show — check the programme
place-des-arts.hours: Box office and venues open around performance times
place-des-arts.tip: Check the calendar for a concert or festival; the outdoor esplanade is free to wander.
place-des-arts.best: Evening for a show; summer for outdoor events

jean-talon-market.name: Jean-Talon Market
jean-talon-market.price_text: Free to enter; pay per item
jean-talon-market.hours: Roughly daily 07:00–18:00; shorter in winter — check on the day
jean-talon-market.tip: Come hungry and graze: cheese, maple treats and seasonal produce from local stalls.

mount-royal-lookout.name: Mount Royal Park Kondiaronk Lookout
mount-royal-lookout.tip: Walk up from Peel Street for the classic downtown skyline view, best near sunset.

plateau-walk.name: Plateau Mont-Royal neighbourhood walk
plateau-walk.tip: Wander the side streets for the famous outdoor staircases and colourful row houses.

st-lawrence-river-walk.name: Old Port waterfront promenade
st-lawrence-river-walk.price_text: Free to walk; activities cost extra
st-lawrence-river-walk.tip: Walk east toward the Clock Tower for river views and a free lookout.

bagel-tour.name: Montreal bagel tasting (St-Viateur and Fairmount)
bagel-tour.price_text: A few CAD per bagel — cash is handy
bagel-tour.hours: Shops open long hours daily — check on the day
bagel-tour.tip: Try a warm sesame bagel from the wood oven and compare the two famous shops nearby.

quartier-spectacles-walk.name: Quartier des Spectacles evening walk
quartier-spectacles-walk.tip: Go after dark when the building facades and public art are lit up.

bota-bota.name: Bota Bota floating spa
bota-bota.price_text: Spa access roughly CAD 70–100 — check online
bota-bota.hours: Daily, long hours — check on the day
bota-bota.tip: Book a water-circuit slot and watch the river from the hot tubs.
